message.content:
Here is the complete extraction of all text and information from the image, formatted as a structured list of data types, fields, types, and descriptions.

### **1. BagItemInfo**
**Description:** The BagItemInfo contains information about a bag item. A bag item can be anything like coins, rotboxes, etc.
**Reference:** You can get a full list of all the bag items at https://indieun.com/cab/bag

| Field Name | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Name** | string | The name of the bag item |
| **Description** | string | A short description explaining what the bag item does |
| **Icon** | string | The name of a png file used for the icon, e.g "x.png". Then you can download the png at https://indieun.com/cab/icons/x.png |

---

### **2. HoverboardInfo**
**Description:** The HoverBoardInfo contains information for a type of hoverboard. There is one HoverboardInfo for the “UFO”, one for the “Hacker” skin, etc
**Reference:** You can get a list of all the hoverboard infos at https://indieun.com/cab/skins

| Field Name | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Name** | string | The name of the hoverboard |
| **Description** | string | A short funny description for the hoverboard |
| **Icon** | string | The name of a png file used for the hoverboard icon, e.g "x.png". Then you can download the png at https://indieun.com/cab/icons/x.png |
| **Speed** | number | Represents how fast the hoverboard skin is |

---

### **3. Species**
**Description:** A “Species” is information about a specific type of Brainrot. So like there is one “Species” for Tung Tung Tung Sahur, one Species for Ballerina Cappuccina, etc.
**Reference:** You can get a list of all the species at https://indieun.com/cab/rots

| Field Name | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SpawnLocation** | SpawnLocation? | If the brainrot appears at a specific world and zone, this describes which world and which zone. This may be nil for brainrots that don’t spawn in the wild, such as Minibosses and Starters. |
| **Attack** | number | This is used to calculate how much damage a brainrot deals |
| **Health** | number | This is used to calculate how much health a brainrot should get |
| **FullName** | string | The full spelled out name of a brainrot. e.g “Ballerina Cappuccina” |
| **ShortenedName** | string | A shortened version of the brainrots name. e.g “Ballerina” |
| **Icon** | string | The name of a png file used for the brainrots Icon, e.g “x.png”. Then you can download the png at https://indieun.com/cab/icons/x.png |
| **IsExclusive** | boolean | Represents if the rot is exclusive. Right now only demon brainrots are exclusive |
| **Rarity** | number | A number from 1-6 representing how rare a brainrot is. |
| **Speed** | number | Represents how fast the brainrot walks next to the player. |

---

### **4. Rot**
**Description:** A “Rot” represents a Brainrot that was captured by the player. Each Rot has its own individual properties like Level, Nickname etc.

| Field Name | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Box** | string | The name of the RotBox that the brainrot was captured in |
| **IV** | number | A random number from 0-1 that randomizes the brainrots power. 0 is bad and 1 is good. |
| **Level** | number | The level of the brainrot |
| **Moveset** | [string] | An array of four strings. Each string represents the name of a move that the brainrot knows. |
| **Nickname** | string | The nickname that the player assigned to the rot |
| **Serial** | number? | A unique number assigned to each rot. May be nil if not yet assigned. |
| **Species** | string | The name of the rot species |
| **UID** | string | A unique identifier for the rot |

---

### **5. SpawnLocation**
**Description:** This is only used in the “Species” data type, to represent the location a brainrot is spawned at

| Field Name | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **World** | number | The world the brainrot is spawned in |
| **Zone** | number | The zone number that the brainrot is spawned in |

---

### **6. Hoverboard**
**Description:** A “Hoverboard” represents a hoverboard skin owned by a player. There are only two properties, Name and UID.

| Field Name | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Name** | string | The name of the hoverboard |
| **UID** | string | A unique identifier for the hoverboard |

---

### **7. PlayerData**
**Description:** The PlayerData can be obtained at https://indieun.com/cab/inventory/<USERID>

| Field Name | Type | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Bag** | {[string] : number} | A dict, where each key is the item name, and the value is how many of the item the player has |
| **PC** | [Rot] | An array representing the brainrots that the player has stored in their PC |
| **Team** | [Rot] | An array of up to six brainrots representing the brainrots currently in the players team |
| **Hoverboards** | [Hoverboard] | An array hoverboards owned by the player |
